name: Sabey Data Centers Ashburn - Building C

source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Building C at Sabey's Ashburn campus publishes 54 MW of IT capacity, ranking sixth among Virginia facilities on this site with disclosed megawatt figures and accounting for roughly 4 percent of the 1,326 MW total across those 19 facilities.

The 54 MW figure sets a hard ceiling on compute density. At 40 kW per rack, a density common for GPU training servers, this power budget supports roughly 1,350 racks. At 10 kW per rack, a more conservative colocation assumption, it supports roughly 5,400 racks. The operator publishes no rack count, cooling architecture, or power density per cabinet, so which end of that range is achievable here cannot be determined from available data.

The facility holds six security and compliance certifications: SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and SSAE 18. These qualifications enable the building to host workloads subject to financial audit controls, security and availability controls, payment card requirements, regulated health data, and international information security standards. This certification profile makes the facility eligible for regulated enterprise and government AI workloads, not only hyperscale training clusters.

Virginia contains 326 mapped facilities in this dataset. Fewer than two dozen publish a capacity figure. The true share of state compute capacity this building represents is therefore unknown, as is the identity of its actual tenants.
